name: Ferienwohnung Bucher
beschreibung:
Quietly located in a natural setting in Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Bucher welcomes visitors with warm Tyrolean charm. The lovingly maintained apartment provides all comforts needed for couples or families.

Hikes into the Kaiser mountains, cycle trips along the Inn River, and visits to the Kufstein Fortress are readily accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Bucher in Ebbs offers cosy holiday accommodation in a peaceful village setting in Kufsteinerland.
